title.zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5.5 及系统卡
title.en: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 5.5 and its system card

current_state.zh: Sonnet 5.5 已发布，并成为首个配备防「推理抽取」绑定与分类器的 Sonnet 模型。
current_state.en: Sonnet 5.5 has been released and is the first Sonnet model with anti-reasoning extraction account binding and a classifier.

updates.what_changed_zh: Anthropic宣布发布Claude Sonnet 5.5，这是其中端前沿模型系列的最新版本。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic announced the release of Claude Sonnet 5.5, the latest iteration of its mid-tier frontier model family.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic宣布发布Claude Sonnet 5.5，这是其中端前沿模型系列的最新版本。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic announced the release of Claude Sonnet 5.5, the latest iteration of its mid-tier frontier model family.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic announced the release of Claude Sonnet 5.5, the latest iteration of its mid-tier frontier model family.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic announced the release of Claude Sonnet 5.5, the latest iteration of its mid-tier frontier model family.

updates.title_zh: Sonnet 5.5成首个防「推理抽取」的Sonnet：内部思考开始绑定账号
updates.title_en: Sonnet 5.5成首个防「推理抽取」的Sonnet：内部思考开始绑定账号
updates.what_changed_zh: Anthropic 为 Sonnet 5.5 增加了防「推理抽取」保护措施：生成的 thinking block 会绑定到原账号或组织，并加入分类器检测大规模套取推理用于蒸馏的行为。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic added anti-reasoning extraction safeguards to Sonnet 5.5: generated thinking blocks are bound to the originating account or organization, and a classifier detects large-scale harvesting of reasoning for distillation.
updates.current_state_zh: Sonnet 5.5 已发布，并成为首个配备防「推理抽取」绑定与分类器的 Sonnet 模型。
updates.current_state_en: Sonnet 5.5 has been released and is the first Sonnet model with anti-reasoning extraction account binding and a classifier.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic has made Sonnet 5.5 its first Sonnet with anti-"reasoning extraction" safeguards, binding generated thinking blocks to the originating account or organization and adding a classifier that detects large-scale harvesting of Claude reasoning for training rival models.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic has made Sonnet 5.5 its first Sonnet with anti-"reasoning extraction" safeguards, binding generated thinking blocks to the originating account or organization and adding a classifier that detects large-scale harvesting of Claude reasoning for training rival models.
